ruleset.name: Syncope code smells
ruleset.description:
Ruleset used to count maintainability, design, correctness, concurrency and performance code smells. Code-style, documentation and security vulnerability rules are intentionally excluded.
The Java security category is intentionally not loaded because its HardCodedCryptoKey and InsecureCryptoIv rules may trigger an internal PMD error on some modern Java source constructs. Those findings are security vulnerabilities rather than maintainability code smells.
